name: 4hub
description: 4HUB - responsive web application for a trading community and premium trading-content platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,blue "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
